name: com.swirepay.android_sdk.ui.nativepayment.NativePaymentActivity
description: The Swirepay Android SDK uses this native form to create a payment link. It collects an amount and customer contact details, lets the user choose payment methods and email or text notifications, then sends the request to Swirepay.
disableEffect: The app cannot create payment links through this Swirepay form.
